usage: migrate_legacy.py [-h] [--source SOURCE] [--project PROJECT]
                         [--dir DIR] [--orphan-status ORPHAN_STATUS]
                         [--threshold THRESHOLD] [--dry-run]

Migrate plans from the old plan-memory database to docs/plans files

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source SOURCE       Legacy ChromaDB folder (default: the plan-memory
                        database path)
  --project PROJECT     Project name (default: from the repository)
  --dir DIR             Project directory (default: current)
  --orphan-status ORPHAN_STATUS
                        Status for plan files with no database entry
  --threshold THRESHOLD
                        Content similarity needed to pair a file with a plan
                        under another ID
  --dry-run             Only show what would be done
